fixes: Every pinned folder now allows write sharing but still never delete sharing. Read-only sharing on the ancestors (drive root, Users, home, AppData, Local) would, for up to the 30-second update, make other programs' saves by rename into those folders fail with a sharing violation, because a rename opens its target folder for writing; it would also fail the cache when another program already had one open for writing. Missing delete sharing alone pins the folders against rename or replacement.

Publication uses FileRenameInfoEx with REPLACE_IF_EXISTS | POSIX_SEMANTICS, so an update can replace current.json or previous.json while another process is reading it; that reader keeps the old generation. Only ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION/NOT_SUPPORTED/INVALID_PARAMETER falls back to the classic rename, which cannot replace a file with open handles; any other failure is reported.
